situation: Two fishing fleets share one stock — cooperating (light quotas) keeps the sea rich, overfishing depletes it and shifts the whole game toward a race to the bottom

players.name: FleetNorth
players.note: Will hold quotas if the other does, but tempted when the stock still looks full

players.name: FleetSouth
players.note: Conditional cooperator, remembers a raided season

rationale.R: both hold quotas while the sea is rich = steady shared catch
rationale.T: overfish once while they hold = a bumper season
rationale.P: both overfish = a lean grind for everyone
rationale.S: hold quota while they raid = you lose the season
rationale.w: the fishery lasts many seasons unless a stock collapse ends it
rationale.noise: a misreported catch or a bad-weather season read as cheating
rationale.eco: A1 is the depleted sea where even mutual restraint pays little; theta = how much restraint replenishes; epsilon = how fast the stock responds; n0 = how healthy it starts
